// FrontendUrl NOTE: Not a secret - set this to the real production frontend origin.

ConnectionStrings.// NOTE: Do NOT put the real production connection string here. This file is committed to source control. Supply the real value on the server via an environment variable (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection) or a machine-level appsettings.Production.json that is NOT part of the git repository - the same discipline used for backend/.env in the current Node.js app, which this replaces.

AI.// NOTE: Do NOT put the real API key here - same discipline as ConnectionStrings above. Supply it via an environment variable (AI__ApiKey) on the server.

Playwright.// NOTE: Not a secret. Set WorkingDirectory to the real server path of the repo root (containing playwright.config.js/package.json).

Jwt.// NOTE: Do NOT put the real secret here - same discipline as ConnectionStrings above. Supply it via an environment variable (Jwt__Secret) on the server. Use a DIFFERENT secret per environment (dev/staging/production) so a token issued by one can never validate against another.
